name: Kalshi BTC market rules card
description: Full-replacement rules card for one automatically bound Kalshi KXBTC15M market generation. The exact ticker, fifteen-minute window, strike, and archived rules come from validated keyless REST discovery. settlement_benchmark identifies the CF Benchmarks BRTI sixty-print simple average, comparator is greater-than-or-equal, and an exact tie pays YES. These values are first-class and must not be treated as equivalent to Polymarket's Chainlink TWAP. A market_transition bound frame precedes the first update for a generation, and an unavailable frame plus degraded batch ends it. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
